summary: Q2 final day. Three positions close: NVDA reconstitution long expires as Stop Day 2 forced-exit threshold triggers ($194.97 June 29, -3.7%); IWM Great Rotation conditional never initiated (PCE 4.1% and VIX above 17 prevented 2-of-3 gate clearance, 0% impact); GOOGL AI talent drain short closed thesis-broken as Dow inclusion creates a structural counter-catalyst and morning briefing pivots to a long entry zone ($345–352, -2.7%). Three new positions open: short NVDA July 11 $190 puts on reconstitution exhaustion signal ($193.85, medium conviction, 8%); long GOOGL on Dow inclusion institutional buying tail ($350.80, medium conviction, 4%); long XLF on SCOTUS Fed independence ruling and BofA 3-hike NIM expansion thesis ($53.76, medium conviction, 3%). Book now at 19 active positions. Active book is balanced: 10 long, 7 short, 1 long-vol (TLT), 1 short-vol (QQQ puts as binary). NFP Thursday July 2 (consensus 170K) is the next macro binary.

closed_today.note: 1-2 day reconstitution flow trade reached its planned expiry date. NVDA never cleared Target 1 ($210); Stop Day 2 forced-exit framework (June 29 close $194.97 < $195 threshold) and sustained institutional selling overwhelmed the passive reconstitution bid. Two-close stop at $193 was not formally triggered (June 29 close $194.97 > $193). Expired June 30 with NVDA at $194.97 (June 29 close).

Required 2-of-3 conditional gates to clear within 5 trading days (by June 27). Only Gate 1 cleared (MU Q3 beat ✓). Gate 2 failed: PCE printed 4.1% YoY on June 25 vs the required ≤3.8% threshold. Gate 3 failed: VIX never closed below 17.0 for two consecutive sessions (est. June 29 close ~17.65). Entry was never initiated per the conditional framework. Position closed per the built-in invalidation clause with zero P&L impact.

Alphabet's addition to the Dow Jones Industrial Average (effective June 29, 2026) created a 2-4 week institutional rebalancing buying tail that is now the dominant near-term GOOGL driver. GOOGL surged +5% on Dow Day 1 (June 29) to ~$357, absorbing and reversing the AI talent drain momentum. The $375 formal stop was not hit, but the Dow inclusion represents an unanticipated structural catalyst that directly competes with the talent drain thesis over the same 2-4 week horizon. Morning briefing (June 30) identifies GOOGL $345-352 pullback as a long entry zone. Closing to initiate the Dow inclusion long thesis.
